svg.title: A dated stored notice records a model replacement
svg.desc: Keep the stored replacement notice as a dated production record. Its typography and source context distinguish it from reconstructed dialogue or incident evidence.

Its typography and source context distinguish it from reconstructed dialogue or incident evidence.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-creator-production-tooling", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "terminal", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "5 SEPTEMBER 2026", "label_box": [ 0.20679999999999998, 0.531, 0.5496, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Location:** `creator-production-tooling`

**Frame:** A stored notice, set as a dated record rather than as speech. `5 SEPTEMBER 2026,
19:17 LOCAL`. It reports that a safeguard flagged the request, that the model in use has
been replaced mid-task, and it gives its reason as one bracketed word.

**Screen / system text — STORED NOTICE (PARAPHRASED):**
`SAFEGUARDS FLAGGED THIS REQUEST. THE MODEL HAS BEEN SWITCHED.`

`DETAILS: [CYBER]`

**Action:** The instrument interrupts the work and names a category.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `CI-REFUSAL`, Event B, recovered from this project's own
transcript store. What the work was at that moment: a coverage validator for the prose
retelling, which had just reported that no page of it was written yet.

", "title": "A dated stored notice records a model replacement" } }
